frequency_question: How often do actions regarding the countercyclical capital buffer officially satisfy the formal criteria of being increased above 0% when policy adjustments are debated?
membership_rule: Includes any formal policy decision meeting of the Federal Reserve Board of Governors where the CCyB rate is explicitly on the agenda for adjustment; excludes routine capital adequacy requirements that are not the CCyB.
provenance_note: rate of 0% from only 5 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 5 major periodic reviews identified where the Fed explicitly evaluated and kept the CCyB at 0% or lowered it.
known_gaps: Intermeeting informal discussions or preliminary staff memos not resulting in an official press release vote.
skeleton: Regulatory review cycles since framework inception where buffer levels were maintained at 0% or reduced, compared to the total number of times an increase above 0% was officially announced.
multiplier: 0 hits out of 5 documented formal review cycles equals 0% historical incidence of the substantive action satisfying the criteria of being set above 0%.
validity_reason: The institutional framework and regulatory inertia surrounding the U.S. CCyB implementation remain stable over multi-year horizons.
